changelog.0.6.0: Rename convention-dependent scan parameters and live ports to az_coordinates and el_coordinates
changelog.0.5.0: Reject non-finite scan coordinates and direction-cosine axis values outside [-1, 1]
changelog.0.4.0: Cleanup: exact optional mask, cached grids, reusable eigenspace and smoothing workspace, exact-rank contract, all-live timing, and a model-order sweep
changelog.0.3.0: Document radar_boresight as the default angle convention
changelog.0.2.0: HSDK 5 migration: Operator<MUSICParams>, typed Tensor ports, OnEach contract, single-tick POD live Inputs, always-emit optional outputs, stop() MatX teardown
changelog.0.1.0: Subspace MUSIC: covariance + eig (VECTOR) + noise-subspace projector + pseudospectrum + dominant DOA; num_sources fixed/auto (EFT); max_sources/doa_multi/source_count; eigenvalues; spatial_smoothing reused from MVDR. Python bindings + pytest.
